glossary.definition: The ability to apply knowledge and skills to achieve intended results, as cited in the APG guidance from ISO 9000:2015.
A way to relate people and their assessed levels to tasks or competencies; the organization must define what each level means.
A recognized qualification where one is applicable; it is distinct from the broader ability to perform competently.
Information retained as evidence; the APG guidance says the organization decides what evidence of competence is appropriate.
The role accountable for decisions and records in a defined workflow.
A local decision state indicating that a person’s record set for a task meets the team’s agreed rules.
A local decision state for a person whose learning is complete or under way but whose required practical evaluation is missing or not yet recorded.
A local decision state indicating that no record supports the assignment.
A record of each claim, its test, what was observed and its disposition.
The product families, equipment, shifts or conditions covered by a task definition.
A statement of what a person has demonstrated for a task.
A record documenting that an action took place; it does not by itself prove that a person can perform the task.
Whether the person finished the action.
Whether the action produced the competence needed for the task.
The moment the new system becomes the place where staffing decisions are made.
A record disposition for evidence that has the context its kind needs and refers to a requirement the team still recognizes.
A record disposition for evidence that is plausible but incomplete.
A record disposition for evidence that cannot be tied to a person or task, conflicts with another record, or has no evident source.
A record of demonstrated performance at a point in time.
A limited-scope test of the workflow under conditions close to real use.
A record of observed decisions, issues, owners and dates for resolution.

recordNames: Approved FAQ answers and source references

example.label: Illustrative example
example.description: An unnamed Canadian manufacturer evaluates training and competency management software for one production workflow; all situations and records are hypothetical, not customer results.

reviewedChapters.title: Map the qualification decision at the production cell
reviewedChapters.summary: The previous finding is resolved: an expired required qualification now blocks assignment until resolved. The changed paragraph presents no clear new problem.
decisions: Assign a person supported by current evidence or hold the assignment.
Identify evidence locations and handoff owners.
Classify a person’s evidence and define state transitions.
Resolve uncertain evidence and choose an interim safe action.
Block assignment when a required qualification has expired.

reviewedChapters.title: Evaluate ICC against the actual decision
reviewedChapters.summary: The prior page-heading finding is resolved: the body begins with an H2 and does not duplicate the page-shell H1. No changed paragraphs were submitted for review.
decisions: Select published claims to verify in a demonstration.
Determine whether evidence review and access arrangements meet local needs.
Classify demonstration outcomes and record limitations or outstanding questions.
Accept, clarify or reject unresolved conditions before a purchasing decision.

reviewedChapters.title: Define task requirements and the competency matrix
reviewedChapters.summary: The earlier attribution finding is resolved: the change triggers are presented as local guidance, and the APG statement is supported. The changed paragraphs present no clear new problems.
decisions: Approve the competence needed for each task and resolve unclear task scope or intended results.
Define level meanings, evidence thresholds and required qualification conditions.
Block assignment when a required qualification or its scope cannot be confirmed.
Assign separate ownership for task requirements and individual competence status.
Approve revised requirements and identify affected people.
Determine whether existing evidence covers changed work and apply an interim rule when the effect is unresolved.
Record open software evaluation questions and any needed manual steps.

reviewedChapters.title: Choose actions to close competence gaps
reviewedChapters.summary: Both previous findings are resolved, and the changed paragraphs present no clear new problems.
decisions: Select a proportionate action and responsible trainer or provider for the gap.
Record an exception and decide on interim staffing and escalation when no suitable action is available.
Confirm completion or record incomplete work and outstanding assessment.
Resolve disputed or incomplete sign-off while controlling independent assignment.
Reschedule overdue learning and select an evidenced replacement or hold the work.
Communicate competence requirements to external providers and retain relevant evidence.

reviewedChapters.title: Verify competence in practical work
reviewedChapters.summary: The previous finding is resolved: the assessment record now requires an unambiguous assessor identifier. The changed paragraphs present no clear new problems.
decisions: Choose and conduct an assessment suited to the task.
Decide whether a simulation, delay or other route is acceptable when observation or an assessor is unavailable.
Determine whether combined evidence supports the task decision.
Keep a person out of independent work when required evidence is missing.
Plan further action and reassessment after an unsuccessful assessment.
Arrange interim coverage or escalate when no evidenced person is available.
Decide what to retain outside the system if it cannot show the assessment history.

reviewedChapters.title: Maintain validity and retrieve evidence
reviewedChapters.summary: The previous finding is resolved: every unresolved gap must now have an owner and due date. No clear problems were found in the changed paragraphs.
decisions: Confirm qualification validity and scope or withhold reliance.
Determine when a change or interval requires review.
Choose supervised work, an evidenced colleague or a delay when a review is late, subject to qualification conditions.
Identify and explain evidence for a sampled person.
Record and resolve missing or inconsistent evidence.
Determine how to track reviews if system notifications are unavailable.

reviewedChapters.title: Migrate records without creating false qualifications
reviewedChapters.summary: Both earlier findings are resolved. The changed paragraphs present no clear new problems.
decisions: Classify legacy records as usable, needing review, or unsuitable for reliance.
Decide whether each record is transferred or retained outside the system.
Accept the pilot transfer or correct the mapping and repeat it.
Designate the authoritative source during transition and assign discrepancy resolution.
Authorize or delay cutover, including a partial cutover for reconciled tasks.
Define when to roll back or use the fallback route.
Restrict or hold work when sufficient alternative evidence or required qualifications cannot be confirmed.

reviewedChapters.title: Pilot the workflow with supervisors and learners
reviewedChapters.summary: All previous findings are resolved. The changed paragraphs present no clear new problems.
decisions: Select role-specific practice tasks and support.
Assign ownership and decide whether the pilot waits when a role cannot access or complete a required task.
Compare pilot decisions with locally approved rules.
Accept the pilot, accept it with conditions, or assign corrective actions before another trial.
Set local acceptance thresholds and determine how missed thresholds affect expansion.
Expand, repeat the pilot or pause based on readiness and support capacity.
Assign support contacts and action owners after expansion.

reviewedChapters.title: Review performance and prepare the next decision
reviewedChapters.summary: The prior citation finding is resolved. No clear new problems were found in the changed paragraphs.
decisions: Prioritize corrective actions or workflow improvements from review findings.
Treat insufficient evidence as a review finding.
Choose a review interval and owner.
Answer FAQ questions within the evidence or refer interpretation questions to an adviser.
Classify legacy records for migration, review or separate retention.
Choose an evidenced replacement, permitted supervision or a hold when staffing evidence is missing.
Proceed, seek clarification or reject the software option based on the demonstration and open conditions.
